notes.title: Controller Support
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39943638/eaee2675c3f6ddb3806412d8f90e32227e15c513.png[/img]


Theoretically, every game pad should work. However, I'm poor and  I don't have the chance to test them all. If the buttons do not work, do not forget to assign keys from the settings. If you have a cheap gamepad like me, You can run it thanks to https://www.x360ce.com/.

By the way, it was a difficult process for me, I added console support to the game for the first time, after failing for 2 days, it was solved very easily thanks to Rama UE4 Plugins. The Unreal community is really helpful.

Anyway, I hope it runs smoothly on your controllers.
If it works or doesn't work, I would appreciate it if you let me know.

Best regards

Okan.

notes.title: Ready For Full Release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39943638/532a472d163a4f797bd28a9783fb492a15d4b836.png[/img]

Finally I completed all the levels and characters. I cleared all the bugs I could find and I think I adjusted the power balance of the characters well.

I said it would be a game that would take around 3 hours, but it could be played longer due to the difficulty level. Of course, it may have seemed that way to me because I'm not a very good player. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39943638/6cd59838e0b23ec0af66a6c28f6110fafd918fef.png[/img]

I didn't expand the Arena mode, the game itself is already quite rewarding. If the player base grows and there is demand, I will look into it in the future.

I'm very content with what I did with  audio storytelling and very fluid combat. I hope you enjoy it too. Don't forget to report any bugs you find and make review on the game. Bye for now.

regards
Okan

notes.title: KARABASAN
notes.content:
[h1]KARABASAN[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39943638/437ad9a0020b86973cfbff41fedda31755ce6217.png[/img]

It is a being that sometimes carries the narratives that Erlik Khan sent to shamans as a warning, and sometimes haunts people's sleep as a punishment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39943638/7676f4a0b3eb4a823bb2fff4b642dd83e3f9da3f.png[/img]

notes.title: Bayanay The Forest Goddess Fifth Boss of the Seven Hell
notes.content:
[h1][b]BAYANAY[/b][/h1]
The mother of the guardian spirits of the forests. fifth boss of the seven hells.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39943638/8d036ca1aedc5ca4344b91401d4d4153cdc77f56.png[/img]

Bayanay is the compassionate goddess of the north and the black forest at the foot of the God Mountains. Although she is known for her gentle and compassionate nature, she is known for her ruthlessness towards those who betray the forest and rivers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39943638/f846645b5d849988b4683c98e7354fc147c52420.png[/img]

During the collapse of the heavens, she asked Erlik Khan to take shelter in Tamag. When she finds the opportunity to return to the world after ages, he betrays Erlik Khan.

notes.title: The 4th boss of the Seven Hells is Deli Dumrul
notes.content:
[b]DELİ DUMRUL[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39943638/003d1d2f6f03a559f57da317439f81c677487cf7.png[/img]

The 4th boss of the Seven Hells is Deli Dumrul, one of the legendary Turkish alps.

Deli Dumrul, a brave man who challenged the gods with his grandeur and crazy courage, even though he was forgiven the first time, he fell out of favor with the gods due to his subsequent excesses and eventually found himself in oblivion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39943638/970b04de0b8dd9344ee2abd5166dd3f65c669c3f.png[/img]


On the way to deeper depths, He has blocked the bridge as usual and continues to cause problems for those passing by. Are you ready to fight him with the traps he set on the bridge?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39943638/9b5c0159f1a6a001ea6ba68e2b7e4375d87c941a.png[/img]

notes.title: Third Boss of Seven Hells KARA MERGEN
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39943638/7dfff3455e8e2e77a04ebfa6634a5ac4dfcdc2a5.png[/img]

Kara Mergen is the greatest of the fallen shamans. Unlike the wise god Mergen, he strengthens himself with dark teachings. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39943638/96fa7f7a0597417259e3016d56ad8d411d52a8a6.png[/img]

It is one of the biggest obstacles in Erlik Khan's return to the world.

notes.title: Seven Hells Second Boss " Bilge Han"
notes.content:
BILGE KHAN

Second boss of the Seven Hells

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39943638/c2fa9d8537c223af91e4b38972b7b33c46e33103.png[/img]

Bilge Khan cannot accept the death of his brother Tonyukuk and goes to Tamag to bring him back, crosses the Karakam road and makes offerings to Erlik Khan to return his brother. However, Erlik Khan rejects the sacrifice and orders him to return.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39943638/6cd59838e0b23ec0af66a6c28f6110fafd918fef.png[/img]

Instead of returning, Bilge Han challenges Erlik Khan to be with his brother again, even though he knows he cannot win. The duel lasts for days, but in the end Erlik Khan emerges victorious. Erlik Khan imprisons him in Tamag because of this behavior. That day, Bilge Han learns that his brother is not in Tamag, but in Uçmag.

notes.title: Sea of Forgotten and Albastı
notes.content:
[b]SEA OF FORGOTTEN[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39943638/12da883fbf5563d5361b105db6dc96ac4ae807c4.png[/img]

Spirits whose names are forgotten in the world sometimes escape to the world and punish their tribes, sometimes they enter the family members who have forgotten them.

These souls captured by the Black Shaman are presented to Karash Khan and thrown into the sea so that they will never escape again. Only a fearless and previously victorious shaman can cross these bridges without fear.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39943638/6c7cb3b59f6cf8106c77649ee29203b01b5dffcb.png[/img]

[b]ALBASTI[/b]

They are known by names such as kormös, Alban, but the most famous of them is Albastı. It is said that the Itbarak lineage comes from her. After the Itbaraks were destroyed, she died of grief and haunted the tribes that destroyed them. 

She kidnapped human children, drove mothers crazy, and eventually drew the wrath of Erlik Khan. Erlik Khan blessed a brave tribal woman and taught her the necessary methods to fight against these spirits, making her the first black shaman. Since then, dark shamans have been hunting these dark spirits.

[previewyoutube=SGK-302DWAA;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Hall of Desires
notes.content:
[b]HALL OF DESIRES[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39943638/ecf04020ab48b88c430ba958bfdd128f5de69c63.png[/img]

4th level of Karakam Way. Haunted by Oburs who are waiting to feed on your desires and dreams.
Shamans need to be focus on their desire to meet with Erlik Khan otherwise they will seduced by the Oburs and they will imprison in torture rooms to feed Oburs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39943638/50c393f91da303989f2c1bb15695ab9612e03c5b.png[/img]

[b]OBURS AND KARAKASH KHAN[/b]

Obur's are the minions of the Karash Khan, who is ruler of the nightand master of the night creatures.
Obur attacks fast and it can rejuvenate themself with every successful hit.
Prime Oburs have a ray of death ability and Karash Khan can cast deadly meteors on you.
